subject: furion_teleportation
definition: 闪烁、冲刺、跳跃、传送等主动改变自身位置
evidence: 传送到地图上任何位置。
Teleports to any point on the map.

context.description_en: Teleports to any point on the map. Gains a barrier after arriving to its destination.
context.description_zh: 传送到地图上任何位置。到达地点后获得一个护盾。
notes_en: Mana and cooldown take effect when the cast is completed.  Nature's Prophet will not use any mana or waste the cooldown if the spell is interrupted while casting.
When the cast begins, an effect is created at the target location, which is visible to allies and enemies.
notes_zh: 魔耗和冷却时间都是在技能施放结束后结算。自然先知在施放技能时被打断将不会耗费魔法或使技能进入冷却。
施法开始后，目标地点将产生视觉特效，对队友和敌人均可见。

subject: huskar_life_break
definition: 闪烁、冲刺、跳跃、传送等主动改变自身位置
evidence: 哈斯卡在跳跃过程中为减益免疫，并且魔法抗性提升%immunity_resist%%%。
015秒内移动1400码以上，跳跃就会停止。
如果哈斯卡在跳跃时受到控制技能，或目标在0.

context.description_en:
Huskar draws upon his health to break an enemy's life, leaping at a target to shatter a percentage of that hero's current health and slow both their movement and attack speed.  While leaping, Huskar is Debuff Immune with %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
context.description_zh:
哈斯卡牺牲自己的生命来摧毁敌人的生命，他跃向一个目标，造成目标当前生命值一定百分比的伤害，并且降低目标的移动和攻击速度。哈斯卡在跳跃过程中为减益免疫，并且魔法抗性提升%immunity_resist%%%。

驱散类型：弱驱散
notes_en: If Huskar is disabled during the charge or the target moves more than 1400 units in 0.015 seconds, the charge stops.
Slow works on Spell Immune units.
Life Break cannot be disjointed.
notes_zh: 如果哈斯卡在跳跃时受到控制技能，或目标在0.015秒内移动1400码以上，跳跃就会停止。
减速效果无视减益免疫。
牺牲无法被躲避。

scepter_loc.en: Forces the enemy target to attack Huskar and increases cast range.
scepter_loc.zh: 强迫敌方目标攻击哈斯卡，并提升施法距离。

subject: magnataur_skewer
definition: 闪烁、冲刺、跳跃、传送等主动改变自身位置
evidence: 马格纳斯向前冲刺，用他巨大的犀角将敌人挑起。

context.description_en: Magnus rushes forward, goring enemy units on his massive tusk. Heroes hit on the way will be dragged to the destination, then damaged and affected by slowed movement speed. The damage is increased based on distance traveled.
context.description_zh: 马格纳斯向前冲刺，用他巨大的犀角将敌人挑起。被击中的英雄将被拽至终点，然后受到伤害并且移动速度被减缓。根据行进的距离伤害也会提升。
notes_en: Skewer is interrupted if Magnus is stunned, hexed or banished.
notes_zh: 马格纳斯受到眩晕、妖术或放逐作用时，巨角冲撞都会被打断。

shard_loc.en: Increases range and deals additional damage when skewering enemies into trees or cliffs.
shard_loc.zh: 提升距离，并且使敌人穿过树木和高台时造成额外伤害。

subject: meepo_poof
definition: 闪烁、冲刺、跳跃、传送等主动改变自身位置
evidence: 可以传送至米波的幻象。
通过从大地中汲取神秘的能量，一个米波可以在持续施法%cast_duration%秒后传送至另一个米波或自身所在之处，在离开和到达的区域都对敌人造成伤害。
Drawing mystical energies from the earth, a Meepo can teleport to another Meepo or itself after channeling for %cast_duration% seconds, damaging the enemy in both the departure and arrival locations.
Can teleport to Meepo illusions.

game_file_fields.AbilityBehavior: DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_POINT | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_UNIT_TARGET | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_NORMAL_WHEN_STOLEN | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_IGNORE_BACKSWING | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_ROOT_DISABLES | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_ALT_CASTABLE

context.description_en: Drawing mystical energies from the earth, a Meepo can teleport to another Meepo or itself after channeling for %cast_duration% seconds, damaging the enemy in both the departure and arrival locations. If the ability is in alt-cast state, all Meepos will also cast Poof to the target. When cast on the ground, all Meepos except the selected one will Poof to the closest location.
context.description_zh: 通过从大地中汲取神秘的能量，一个米波可以在持续施法%cast_duration%秒后传送至另一个米波或自身所在之处，在离开和到达的区域都对敌人造成伤害。如果技能设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标）状态，所有米波也会对目标施放忽悠。对地施放后，除了选中的米波外所有米波会忽悠至最近的地点。
notes_en: Can be cast through the minimap.
Can teleport to Meepo illusions.
notes_zh: 可以点击小地图施放。
可以传送至米波的幻象。

subject: mirana_leap
definition: 闪烁、冲刺、跳跃、传送等主动改变自身位置
evidence: 米拉娜的坐骑向前跳跃加入战斗，发出一声凶狠的咆哮鼓舞它的主人，提升攻击和移动速度。
Mirana leaps forward into battle, empowering herself with a ferocious roar that grants bonus attack and movement speed.

context.description_en: Mirana leaps forward into battle, empowering herself with a ferocious roar that grants bonus attack and movement speed. Speed bonus lasts %leap_bonus_duration% seconds.
context.description_zh: 米拉娜的坐骑向前跳跃加入战斗，发出一声凶狠的咆哮鼓舞它的主人，提升攻击和移动速度。速度加成持续%leap_bonus_duration%秒。

subject: monkey_king_tree_dance
definition: 闪烁、冲刺、跳跃、传送等主动改变自身位置
evidence: 停留时获得乾坤之跃技能——需要持续施法的跳跃式攻击。
While perched, he gains the Primal Spring ability-a channeled leap attack.

context.description_en: Monkey King jumps to a tree and perches atop it. While perched, he gains the Primal Spring ability-a channeled leap attack. If Monkey King's tree is destroyed, he falls and is stunned for %unperched_stunned_duration%s. Taking damage while on the ground puts Tree Dance on cooldown.
context.description_zh: 齐天大圣跳上一棵树并停在上面。停留时获得乾坤之跃技能——需要持续施法的跳跃式攻击。如果树木被摧毁，他将从树上掉下，并眩晕%unperched_stunned_duration%秒。在地面受到伤害时丛林之舞将在一定时间内无法使用，处于冷却状态。
notes_en: Tree Dance cooldown starts upon landing.
Right-clicking the ground will have Monkey King drop from the tree.
Movement is interrupted if Monkey King is stunned, hexed or banished.
notes_zh: 丛林之舞在落地时进入冷却。
右键点击地面后齐天大圣会从树上跳下。
齐天大圣受到眩晕、妖术或放逐作用时位移都会被打断。

subject: overwhelming_blink
definition: 闪烁、冲刺、跳跃、传送等主动改变自身位置
evidence: Self-casting will cause you to teleport in the direction of your team's fountain.

abilities.title: Overwhelming Blink
abilities.description:
Teleport to a target point up to 1200 units away.

After teleportation, all enemies in a 800 AoE take damage equal to 100 + 50% of your strength and an additional 100% over time, and have 50% movement speed slow and 50 attack speed slow for 6 seconds. 

Overwhelming Blink cannot be used for 3 seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.

context.notes: Self-casting will cause you to teleport in the direction of your team's fountain.

subject: pangolier_swashbuckle
definition: 闪烁、冲刺、跳跃、传送等主动改变自身位置
evidence: Pangolier dashes along the target line, then slashes and briefly slows all enemies in the drawn direction with several quick swipes.

context.description_en:
Pangolier dashes along the target line, then slashes and briefly slows all enemies in the drawn direction with several quick swipes.

Lucky Shot has a chance to activate from this damage.
context.description_zh:
石鳞剑士先冲向目标地点，再向指示方向上的所有敌人刺出数剑并减速他们。

刺剑有几率触发幸运一击。
notes_en: Casting Swashbuckle during Rolling Thunder ends Rolling Thunder.
notes_zh: 在地雷滚滚期间施放虚张声势将使地雷滚滚提前结束。

subject: puck_waning_rift
definition: 闪烁、冲刺、跳跃、传送等主动改变自身位置
evidence: Puck teleports to the target location and releases a burst of faerie dust that deals damage and silences enemy units nearby.
帕克传送至目标地点洒出它神秘的仙女粉尘，对周围的敌人造成伤害和沉默。

context.description_en: Puck teleports to the target location and releases a burst of faerie dust that deals damage and silences enemy units nearby.
context.description_zh: 帕克传送至目标地点洒出它神秘的仙女粉尘，对周围的敌人造成伤害和沉默。

subject: queenofpain_blink
definition: 闪烁、冲刺、跳跃、传送等主动改变自身位置
evidence: Short distance teleportation that allows Queen of Pain to move in and out of combat.
闪烁可以躲避多种飞行过程中的攻击和技能弹道。
短距离传送，能让痛苦女王自由出入战场。
You can use Blink to dodge incoming projectiles.

context.description_en: Short distance teleportation that allows Queen of Pain to move in and out of combat.
context.description_zh: 短距离传送，能让痛苦女王自由出入战场。
notes_en: You can use Blink to dodge incoming projectiles.
notes_zh: 闪烁可以躲避多种飞行过程中的攻击和技能弹道。

shard_loc.en: Releases a sonic boom when Queen of Pain blinks, at both her starting and ending locations. Deals %shard_damage% damage in a %shard_aoe% AoE and silences the target for %shard_duration% seconds.
shard_loc.zh: 在痛苦女王的闪烁起点和落地点各释放一次音爆。在%shard_aoe%范围内造成%shard_damage%点伤害，并沉默%shard_duration%秒。

subject: slark_pounce
definition: 闪烁、冲刺、跳跃、传送等主动改变自身位置
evidence: On cast, Slark leaps forward at a speed of %pounce_speed%, stopping when he latches onto an enemy hero or has traveled %pounce_distance% distance.
Slark leaps forward, leashing and applying Essence Shift stacks to the first hero he connects.
斯拉克向前跳跃，束缚第一个碰到的英雄并施加能量转移的叠加效果。
施放后斯拉克以%pounce_speed%的速度向前跳跃，抓住敌方英雄或跳跃%pounce_distance%距离后停下。

context.description_en: Slark leaps forward, leashing and applying Essence Shift stacks to the first hero he connects. That unit can only move a limited distance away from Slark's landing position.
context.description_zh: 斯拉克向前跳跃，束缚第一个碰到的英雄并施加能量转移的叠加效果。该单位只能在斯拉克着地点附近的有限范围内移动。
notes_en: On cast, Slark leaps forward at a speed of %pounce_speed%, stopping when he latches onto an enemy hero or has traveled %pounce_distance% distance.
Debuff Immune units cannot be leashed.
Trees will be destroyed around Slark's landing location.
notes_zh: 施放后斯拉克以%pounce_speed%的速度向前跳跃，抓住敌方英雄或跳跃%pounce_distance%距离后停下。
不能束缚减益免疫单位。
斯拉克落地点附近的树木将会被摧毁。

scepter_loc.zh: 变为充能型技能，并且提升距离。

subject: snapfire_firesnap_cookie
definition: 闪烁、冲刺、跳跃、传送等主动改变自身位置
evidence: 跳跃的单位将在落地时对敌人造成眩晕和伤害。
电炎绝手将一块烈性饼干喂给小莫迪或一名队友，使他们短距离跳跃。

context.description_en: Snapfire feeds a potent cookie to Mortimer or an ally, causing them to hop a short distance. The hopping unit stuns and damages enemies in the landing zone.
context.description_zh: 电炎绝手将一块烈性饼干喂给小莫迪或一名队友，使他们短距离跳跃。跳跃的单位将在落地时对敌人造成眩晕和伤害。
notes_en: The cookie projectile has a speed of %projectile_speed%.
notes_zh: 饼干的弹道速度为%projectile_speed%。

shard_loc.en: Firesnap cookies become even more potent, healing the target and launching a Mortimer Kiss that does %shard_damage_multiplier_tooltip%%% impact damage to the landing destination.
shard_loc.zh: 龙炎饼干变得更具威力，治疗目标，并且朝着陆地点发射一个%shard_damage_multiplier_tooltip%%%冲击伤害的蜥蜴绝吻。

subject: spectre_haunt
definition: 闪烁、冲刺、跳跃、传送等主动改变自身位置
evidence: The Reality sub-ability may be used to teleport to the illusion, destroying it.
子技能空降可以将本体传送至幻象，并将其摧毁。

context.description_en: Creates a spectral nemesis to haunt all enemy Heroes.Haunt illusions are uncontrollable, take extra damage, and deal less damage than Spectre herself.  They ignore terrain.The Reality sub-ability may be used to teleport to the illusion, destroying it.
context.description_zh: 创造一个复仇鬼影分别攻击每个敌方英雄。鬼影无法控制，受到额外伤害，造成的伤害低于幽鬼本体。鬼影移动无视地形。子技能空降可以将本体传送至幻象，并将其摧毁。

scepter_loc.en: The first time Spectre uses Reality on a Haunt illusion, enemies in a %fear_aoe% area around the target are Feared away from Spectre for %fear_duration%s and have their movement speed slowed by %fear_movespeed_slow%%%.Reduces cooldown by %scepter_cooldown_reduction_tooltip%s.
scepter_loc.zh: 幽鬼第一次对鬼影重重的幻象使用空降时，目标附近%fear_aoe%范围内的敌人会被恐惧，朝远离幽鬼的方向奔跑%fear_duration%秒，并且移动速度降低%fear_movespeed_slow%%%。冷却时间减少%scepter_cooldown_reduction_tooltip%秒。

subject: spectre_shadow_step
definition: 闪烁、冲刺、跳跃、传送等主动改变自身位置
evidence: 子技能空降可以将本体传送至幻象，并将其摧毁。
The Reality sub-ability may be used to teleport to the illusion, destroying it.

context.description_en: Sends an uncontrollable illusion at a target that follows and attacks the target.The Reality sub-ability may be used to teleport to the illusion, destroying it.
context.description_zh: 对目标制造一个无法控制的幻象，对其进行攻击。子技能空降可以将本体传送至幻象，并将其摧毁。

subject: spirit_breaker_charge_of_darkness
definition: 闪烁、冲刺、跳跃、传送等主动改变自身位置
evidence: 冲刺指示特效仅对队友可见。
裂魂人在冲刺过程中能穿过树木，悬崖和任何单位。
裂魂人盯紧一个敌方单位，开始无视一切物体的冲刺，起始为%min_movespeed_bonus_pct%%%额外移速，%windup_time%秒后达到最大速度。

context.description_en: Spirit Breaker fixes his sight on an enemy unit and starts charging through all objects, starting at %min_movespeed_bonus_pct%%% of the bonus speed and reaching his max speed after %windup_time%s.All enemy units passed through and the targeted unit will be hit by a Greater Bash.  If the targeted unit dies, Spirit Breaker will change his target to the nearest enemy unit to that location.
context.description_zh: 裂魂人盯紧一个敌方单位，开始无视一切物体的冲刺，起始为%min_movespeed_bonus_pct%%%额外移速，%windup_time%秒后达到最大速度。途中经过的所有敌方单位和目标单位都将受到巨力重击。如果目标单位在到达前阵亡，裂魂人将他的目标改为原路径上最近的一个敌方单位。
notes_en: Spirit Breaker passes through trees, cliffs, and units.
The charge indicator is visible only to allies.
Spirit Breaker gains shared vision of the target.
notes_zh: 裂魂人在冲刺过程中能穿过树木，悬崖和任何单位。
冲刺指示特效仅对队友可见。
裂魂人将获得并共享目标的视野。

context.notes: Self-casting will cause you to teleport in the direction of your team's fountain.

CHANNELED - Allows Templar Assassin to teleport to any Psionic Trap after channeling for %abilitychanneltime% seconds, detonating it upon arrival as if it was fully charged and instantly dealing %extra_damage% bonus damage.

context.description_zh: 持续施法 - 圣堂刺客经过%abilitychanneltime%秒持续施法后可以传送至任意灵能陷阱，到达时引爆灵能陷阱，陷阱总是最大效果，并且立刻造成%extra_damage%点额外伤害。灵能投射在持续施法时不会脱离隐匿效果。

context.description_zh: 宙斯作出神圣一跳，向前跳跃并震击最近的可见敌人（以英雄优先），造成伤害，并减缓其移动速度、攻击速度。宙斯获得附近%vision_radius%范围的顺畅视野，持续3秒。

创造一场静态风暴，在持续时间内伤害并沉默区域内的所有敌方单位。

context.description_zh: 创造一场静态风暴，在持续时间内伤害并沉默区域内的所有敌方单位。伤害刚开始时很低，但会在持续时间内逐渐增加。

释放一阵狂风，沉默敌方单位并将其击退，同时使隐身敌人显形。

context.description_zh: 释放一阵狂风，沉默敌方单位并将其击退，同时使隐身敌人显形。击退距离与敌人和卓尔游侠的距离成反比。

subject: earth_spirit_geomagnetic_grip
definition: 目标无法施放技能（仍可攻击、使用物品）
evidence: Enemies struck by the gripped target will be silenced.
大地之灵将目标残岩或友方单位拉扯到自己所在的位置，行进路径上被击中的敌人都会被沉默并受到伤害。

context.description_en: Earth Spirit pulls the target Stone Remnant or Allied Unit. Enemies struck by the gripped target will be silenced.Pulled Remnants also deal damage to struck enemies.Cast range is reduced when targeting an ally.
context.description_zh: 大地之灵将目标残岩或友方单位拉扯到自己所在的位置，行进路径上被击中的敌人都会被沉默并受到伤害。拉扯的残岩也会对击中的敌人造成伤害。以友军为目标时施法距离减少。
notes_en: Will not work on a unit inside Chronosphere, Duel, or Black Hole.
Geomagnetic Grip can also target allied creeps.
notes_zh: 如果目标处于时间结界，决斗或黑洞之中则不起作用。
地磁之握还可以对友方小兵施放。

shard_loc.en: Decreases cooldown to %AbilityCooldown%s and increases allied unit cast range and pull speed.
shard_loc.zh: 冷却时间减少至%AbilityCooldown%秒，对友方单位的施法距离和牵引速度提升。

subject: grimstroke_ink_creature
definition: 目标无法施放技能（仍可攻击、使用物品）
evidence: Once latched, the phantom damages and silences.
缠住后对其造成伤害和沉默。

context.description_en:
Summons a phantom that moves quickly towards the target, latching to it when she arrives. Once latched, the phantom damages and silences. If she survives the full latch duration she rends her victim for heavy damage and refreshes Phantom's Embrace's cooldown.

Hero attacks against the phantom count as 3 attacks each.
context.description_zh:
召唤一个快速向目标移动的幻影，到达时将其缠住。缠住后对其造成伤害和沉默。若她在纠缠期间存活，将会撕裂目标，造成大量伤害，并刷新戾影的冷却时间。

英雄对幻影的单次攻击记为3次。
notes_en: The phantom falls off if the target becomes invisible or spell immune.
The phantom will return if the target dies during the latch.
notes_zh: 幻影在目标隐身或进入减益免疫状态后掉下。
目标在纠缠期间阵亡后幻影将会回归。

subject: marci_unleash
definition: 目标无法施放技能（仍可攻击、使用物品）
evidence: 玛西的所有怒拳破脉冲都会沉默敌人，持续%pulse_silence_duration%秒。
All of Marci's unleash pulses will silence units for %pulse_silence_duration% seconds.

context.description_en:
Marci taps a hidden power, gaining Fury charges that allow her to deliver a rapid sequence of strikes that slow movement and attack speed of the target for %pulse_debuff_duration%s. The last strike in every Fury combo creates a damaging pulse around the target. In between Fury combos, Marci is unable to attack for %time_between_flurries%s.

Marci gains %bonus_movespeed%%% movement speed when Unleash is cast.
context.description_zh:
玛西释放潜藏的力量，获得狂怒的猛攻效果，使自身可以发动快速的打击，并且降低打击目标的移动和攻击速度，持续%pulse_debuff_duration%秒。每次狂怒连技的最后一击都会创造一个脉冲效果，对目标周围的敌人造成伤害。在狂怒连技的间隔，玛西无法攻击，持续%time_between_flurries%秒。

玛西施放怒拳破时移动速度提升%bonus_movespeed%%%。
notes_en: Once a Fury combo is started, each attack must be delivered within 1s or the Fury combo expires.
Removes attack speed limit.
notes_zh: 每次狂怒连技开始后，每次攻击都必须在1秒内完成，否则连技将会终止。
移除攻击速度限制。

scepter_loc.en: Reduces Unleash cooldown by %scepter_cooldown_reduction% seconds and causes Unleash to apply a basic dispel on Marci. While Unleash is Active, all of Marci's abilities unleash pulses when cast. All of Marci's unleash pulses will silence units for %pulse_silence_duration% seconds.DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
scepter_loc.zh: 怒拳破的冷却时间减少%scepter_cooldown_reduction%秒，并且施放时对玛西施加弱驱散。怒拳破生效期间，玛西的所有技能在施放时都会施放脉冲。玛西的所有怒拳破脉冲都会沉默敌人，持续%pulse_silence_duration%秒。驱散类型：弱驱散
